school_gates.name: School Gates
school_gates.description: Wrought-iron gates at dusk. A queue of new students shuffles toward a brass automaton that checks each in turn.

courtyard.name: Courtyard
courtyard.description: A broad flagstoned courtyard between the two great halls. Building A holds the dormitories; Building B, the amphitheatre.

amphitheater.name: Amphitheatre (Building B)
amphitheater.description: A steep bowl of seats around a speaker's dais. First-years file in for the welcoming ceremony.

room.name: Your Room
room.description: A small dormitory room. A bed, a desk, and a wardrobe.

corridor_a.name: Corridor A
corridor_a.description: A drafty stone corridor linking the dorms to the classrooms.

classroom.name: Classroom
classroom.description: Rows of desks beneath a vaulted, rune-carved ceiling.

corridor_b.name: Corridor B
corridor_b.description: A shorter hall in Building A, hung with duelling trophies.

dueling_room.name: Dueling Room
dueling_room.description: A sand-floored ring warded for magical combat.
